title: FunctionalCompetencyDevelopmentResult
description: Functional competency development output contract emitted by lumei-functional-competency-development-coach.

evidence_reference.description: Traceable pointers to verbatim quotes or documented work outputs.

observed_behaviour.description: Specific technical actions, methods applied, or standards observed.

code.description: Standard Lumei functional code (e.g. ENG-01, PSM-02, DDA-03)

competency_name.description: Exact competency title from Lumei Functional Competency Dictionary v4.0

official_source_reference.description: Page or section reference in [EN] Lumei Functional Competency Dictionary_v4.0 Final.pdf

rationale.description: How the observed action links to the competency definition without scoring

missing_evidence.description: Evidence gaps that prevent stronger alignment

overclaim_risk.description: Risk of confusing job title/attendance with actual demonstrated proficiency

selected_development_edge.description: One bounded technical/functional edge to develop.

evidence_to_collect.description: Concrete outputs, peer reviews, or technical verifications to gather next.

aspiration_language.description: Clearly separated aspirational development statement suitable for IDP.

official_deep_check_required.description: True if Shadow Index was ambiguous or high-consequence context requires mandatory manual PDF verification.
